name: Jockstrap
label: Rough Trade
lede: A jazz violinist and an electronic composer met at conservatoire, named themselves after the least tasteful item in a drawer, and made the year's most restless pop record out of accidents, strings and one laptop that nearly got stolen.

eras.title: Jazz violin meets laptop
eras.text: Georgia Ellery studied jazz violin at London's Guildhall School of Music and Drama; Taylor Skye studied electronic music down the corridor. She asked him to produce her poems-turned-songs, and the duo was a going concern by the end of 2017.

years.cap: Taylor Skye of Jockstrap performing at End of the Road, Dorset, England, 31st August 2024 · Wikimedia
years.src: Wikipedia: Jockstrap · Rolling Stone: Jockstrap interview
years.h: Guildhall: a jazz violinist and an electronic composer
years.p: [[Georgia Ellery|8994432f-57d9-4fe6-adc1-db6674a5fff4]] and [[Taylor Skye|8f9e08b1-545d-499b-b48b-dc8c5a5f037a]] met at the Guildhall School of Music and Drama, where she studied jazz violin and he studied electronic music.
years.xp:
According to Wikipedia, they began working together in September 2017, after Ellery approached Skye to produce her compositions. The name was picked for shock value and memorability, per the same account.

The pattern stuck: Ellery writes, often starting from poems, and sends the songs to Skye to produce, as Rolling Stone described their workflow.

years.src: Wikipedia: Jockstrap · Rolling Stone: Jockstrap interview
years.h: "I Want Another Affair" is the first single
years.p: Jockstrap's first release arrives in late 2017. Their first live show follows in March 2018.

years.src: Wikipedia: Jockstrap · The Quietus: Moments Of Hyperreal Intimacy
years.h: Love Is the Key to the City EP, Kaya Kaya Records
years.p: Songs like "Hayley" and "Charlotte" started as poems about Ellery's time at Guildhall, and a 21-piece string ensemble of fellow students plays on it.
years.xp: Wikipedia lists the EP as the duo's debut release on Kaya Kaya Records. The Quietus interviewed them about it in the week it came out.

eras.title: Warp and the Wicked City
eras.text: A remix EP with homemade videos, a bigger label and a record that pulled in noise and hip-hop. Then a pandemic, and a gallery instead of a video shoot.

years.h: Lost My Key in the <3 Club <3 reworks the debut
years.p: Skye remixes the EP; Ellery directs the videos herself.
Wikipedia places her arrival in the London band shortly after 2018, playing violin and singing, while Jockstrap carries on alongside.
years.xp: She appears on the band's albums For the First Time (2021) and Ants from Up There (2022), according to her Wikipedia page, and on Forever Howlong (2025).

years.src: Wikipedia: Jockstrap · PopMatters: Jockstrap's Wicked City
years.h: Wicked City EP, the first record on Warp
years.p: Electro-noise and experimental hip-hop enter the palette, including "Robert" with the Arizona group [[Injury Reserve|4c4fa077-b351-4558-9013-b31e1fbd1d24]], who took Jockstrap on their UK and Ireland tour.
years.xp:
With venues shut, Jockstrap skipped conventional videos and built a virtual exhibition at implied.gallery. Ellery also improvised for 15 minutes with [[Jamie xx|d1515727-4a93-4c0d-88cb-d7a9fce01879]] on BBC Radio 3's Late Junction.

PopMatters called the EP "an unfolding of boundaries" in July 2020.

eras.title: I Love You Jennifer B
eras.text: Rough Trade takes over, three years of songs come together, and Jockstrap becomes a critics' record of the year.

years.src: Pitchfork: Jockstrap Sign to Rough Trade · Rolling Stone: Jockstrap interview
years.h: Jockstrap sign to Rough Trade with "50/50"
years.p: The move from Warp is announced with a new single, the one song on the album that began as a Skye beat rather than an Ellery poem.
years.xp: Pitchfork reported the signing the same day.

years.h: Ellery sings on Ants from Up There
years.p: Black Country, New Road's second album arrives in the year Isaac Wood leaves, and Ellery shares lead vocals afterwards.

years.big: "That's what I want to hear: the surprise."
years.src: Rolling Stone: Jockstrap interview · Wikipedia: I Love You Jennifer B
years.h: "Concrete Over Water" keeps a slip of the tongue
years.p: A mispronunciation on the single became the final take, Rolling Stone reported. The quote is Ellery on unexpected production choices.
years.xp: The single was followed by "Glasgow" on 14 June.

years.h: A stolen backpack holds the only copy of the album
years.p: [[Taylor Skye|8f9e08b1-545d-499b-b48b-dc8c5a5f037a]]'s laptop was snatched at a North London vegan Chinese restaurant; rapper [[Slowthai|333e76b4-9606-4fd3-bcb3-8e7660bb4d96]] chased the thief and got it back.
years.xp: Rolling Stone reports that Skye's liner note reads: "Ty chased the guy down and got the laptop back."

years.src: Wikipedia: I Love You Jennifer B · The Quietus: Tell Them How You Feel
years.h: I Love You Jennifer B: Pitchfork gives it 8.4
years.p: Pitchfork scored the debut 8.4 and ranked it No. 15 of 2022; Metacritic lists 89 from 15 critics.
years.xp:
Wikipedia reports it entered the UK Albums Chart at No. 57 and reached No. 3 on the UK Independent Albums Chart. DIY ranked it No. 1 of 2022, Clash No. 3, The Line of Best Fit No. 6.

The album runs ten tracks over 44 minutes, with a plain grey cover and stickers for fans to customize.

years.src: NME: Jockstrap share cameo-laden music video
years.p: Directed by Aidan Zamiri, it follows a feuding pop duo in court, with cameos from [[Jamie xx|d1515727-4a93-4c0d-88cb-d7a9fce01879]] and Don Letts and Ellery as the judge's clerk.

eras.title: Shortlisted
eras.text: The debut gets its official honour, and Skye hands the songs to remixers.

years.src: BrooklynVegan: Mercury Prize 2023 shortlist · Wikipedia: Jockstrap
yt: Concrete Over Water at the Mercury Prize 2023
years.h: I Love You Jennifer B makes the Mercury Prize shortlist
years.p: It is one of 12 albums on the 2023 shortlist, with the ceremony at Hammersmith Apollo on 7 September.
years.xp: Jockstrap also played "Concrete Over Water" at Glastonbury 2023.

years.p: Rough Trade releases the remix album with Skye leading production.
